Alex / Chloe —

I can jump on the async preflight right now if you want to give me access to a test box or let me provision a short-lived key for you to try. If you prefer to self-try first, quick steps below to validate the SDK:

1) Unzip the quickstart and install the SDK
   python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
   pip install redwood-sdk==1.2.0

2) Set the API key in env and run the sample
   export REDWOOD_API_KEY="<YOUR_KEY_HERE>"
   python samples/basic_infer.py --model gpt-redwood-small

3) If you hit a TLS/connection error, capture the output into preflight-logs-template.csv and send it back.

If you'd rather we create an ephemeral key for you to test immediately, we'll need the person/email you want the key tied to. I can spin one up that expires in 24 hours and is limited to inference-only.

Example admin command (internal):
  curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.inference/api/v1/keys" \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin_token>" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"owner":"alex@streamlytics.com","notes":"ephemeral test key for Streamlytics"}'

Attachments: preflight-logs-template.csv

If you confirm a preferred slot, Chloe will send an updated invite.

—Monica
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
